taxonomy.note: LIN-3210 (sub-task (c) of LIN-3197): the new detector vocabulary this check-10 coding now carries. The historical LIN-3190 fields (code/why/evidence) are unchanged; newCount/bucket map each sampled alarm to the count or bucket the post-change detectors report.

definitions.doneLoggedAnyway: a hook.done_posted with no ok [done] feedback.post for the item (the old unconditional marker)
definitions.unresolved: a hook.done_post_started with neither a done_posted nor a done_post_failed
definitions.alarmed: a D7 hit joined to a launch.duplicate by (issue|kind, second session id)
definitions.unalarmed: a D7 hit with no matching launch.duplicate, not alreadyEnded and not parkedOnly
definitions.parkedOnly: an unalarmed hit whose first session was parked at the second launch
definitions.alreadyEnded: R2: an unalarmed hit whose first session ended before the second launched (overlapMin === 0)
